prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for echinacea tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single small rustic ceramic mug filled with a russet-amber echinacea infusion, placed slightly off-center (upper left). Scattered around the mug on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: two or three dried purple coneflower (echinacea) blooms with their characteristic drooping deep-violet petals and prominent dark spiky orange-brown central cone, a few loose petals separated from the flowers, two small chips of dried echinacea root (pale tan with darker bark), and one slender green stem. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Petals, cones, and root chips have clean confident silhouettes, not painterly brushstrokes. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The mug has a subtle warm earthy clay tone with a soft glazed rim. Palette stays autumnal — russet, ochre, deep violet, sage. Warm diffuse afternoon light from upper left casts a faint soft shadow below the mug and petals. Feels grounding, immune-fortifying, cozy. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes. Match composition and rendering style of tea-card-chamomile.
